name: 86 Chaos 17.0.36
label: 86 Chaos 17.0.36
notes: Upgrades Firebase Admin from 12.7.0 to 14.5.0, which replaces deprecated url.parse() usage with the WHATWG URL API.
Adds an internal modular Firebase Admin compatibility facade so existing server routes keep their current Auth, Firestore, App Check, Messaging, Storage, and Realtime Database behavior.
Adds targeted regression coverage that rejects legacy firebase-admin namespace imports and verifies the installed Admin SDK no longer contains url.parse() in its request/URL validators.
Preserves the 17.0.35 device-local reminder foundation and the 17.0.34 Restaurant Readiness Command Center.
title: 86 Chaos 17.0.36
summary: Removes the legacy Firebase Admin url.parse() path on Node 24 while preserving existing server behavior.
description: Upgrades Firebase Admin to 14.5.0 and routes legacy 86 Chaos server callers through a modular compatibility facade so Node 24 no longer emits DEP0169 from Firebase Admin.
